title: Foreverworld Essentials
description: This little Modpack is an collection of QoL Vanilla Mods. Which Improve the way of an Foreverworld.
body:
# ✨Foreverwold Essentials✨


It aims to provide a smooth Gameplay with lots of QoL Addons I want to use in our Foreverworld. 

So what does this Modpack Add?


<details>
  <summary>Classic Shaders</summary>

- BSL
  
- Complementary Reimagined
  
- Complementary Unbound
 
- AstraLex



</details>
<details>
  <summary>QoL Mods</summary>

 - Open Chests through Itemframes

 - Better F3

  - Client Sort
  
  - Inventory Particles

  - Light Overlay

  - Litematica 

- And Many More!
</details>

This is the Foreverwold Essentials Modpack created by me (CodenameMomo).
If you have any Suggestions for an Addition to this Modpack you can Contact me on Discord (shinyhuntermomo).
